clue.text: Cavalryman drops round, smart — one's all aflutter

indicators.note: drops means the cavalryman lets go of one of his letters, here the round one

parts.note: a dragoon is a mounted soldier
O is round in shape
fly is slang for sharp or smart

explanation.surface: A horse soldier lets his round of drinks fall while a smart someone flutters about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drops' removes an O from DRAGOON, leaving DRAGON.
explanation.definitionFit: This insect has rapidly beating wings, so it is a creature permanently aflutter.

clue.text: Sanity found in 'About a Boy'?

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: Is mental health found in the novel About a Boy?
explanation.walkthrough: About a Boy is a Nick Hornby novel; 'found in' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To lose one's reason is to lose one's sanity, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Collect two articles in Greece

indicators.note: in puts the articles inside the abbreviation for Greece

parts.note: GR is the international code for Greece
a is the indefinite article
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Picking up a couple of items while in Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather is to bring together, a synonym of collect.

clue.text: Tiny reforms accommodating this Parisian's subtle point

indicators.note: accommodating means the reworked letters hold the French word inside
reforms says the letters of tiny are rearranged

parts.note: ce is French for this

explanation.surface: Small reforms make room for a Frenchman's fine point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reforms' rearranges the letters of 'Tiny' to NITY; 'accommodating' then wraps them around the French word for 'this'.
explanation.definitionFit: A nicety is a fine distinction or detail, a subtle point.

clue.text: Conduct the conga and cause mischief?

definitions.meaning: literally to head a jolly line of dancers
the idiom means to cause someone a lot of trouble

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to give someone a run-around; literally it is heading a lively dance.

clue.text: Male fish or insect

parts.note: a cock is a male bird
a roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Choosing between a male fish and a bug.
explanation.definitionFit: This scuttling creature is a common insect pest.

clue.text: Active Fifties teenager's gone to get equipped

parts.note: fit means healthy and active
Ted, short for Teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth in Edwardian-style clothes
out can mean departed or gone

explanation.surface: A sporty 1950s youth has left to get kitted out.
explanation.walkthrough: Teddy boys were a 1950s British youth subculture; the 's reads as 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: To be fitted out is to be supplied with what is needed, i.e. equipped.

clue.text: Hermit as a result of her action, sadly

indicators.note: sadly suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone became a recluse as a result of her unfortunate action.
explanation.definitionFit: An anchorite is a religious recluse, a synonym of a hermit.

clue.text: Movement provides topic for debate

definitions.meaning: a proposal formally put before a debating assembly

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: physical moving, and a formal proposal for debate.

clue.text: Master of strategy showing diplomacy in charge of Scotsman

parts.note: tact is diplomatic sensitivity
Ian is a typically Scottish first name

explanation.surface: A strategist praised for his diplomacy, put in command of a Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: A tactician is someone skilled at planning moves, a synonym for a strategy expert.

clue.text: Drawing second boat

parts.note: a ketch is a two-masted sailing vessel

explanation.surface: An artist's picture of a second vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough drawing is a synonym, an outline picture made quickly.

clue.text: Some hated building this house

indicators.note: building suggests the letters are assembled into a new construction

explanation.surface: Some people loathed the construction of this dwelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'building' looks like part of the house picture but signals the rearrangement of SOME HATED.
explanation.definitionFit: A homestead is a farmhouse with its outbuildings, so a kind of house.

clue.text: Was successful with left-wing backing, it's a miracle

parts.note: to have won is to have been successful

indicators.note: backing tells us the left-wing word is read in reverse

parts.note: red is a label for the political left

explanation.surface: A victory with the support of the political left is hailed as a miracle.
explanation.definitionFit: A wonder is a marvel or amazing event, synonymous with a miracle.

clue.text: Fellow's let down over drug in plant container

indicators.note: over places the earlier pieces above the drug in this down entry

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fellow
to lower something is to let it down
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A man has lowered some cannabis into a planter.
explanation.definitionFit: A flowerpot is a container for growing a plant.

clue.text: Sign up to be an underwriter?

definitions.meaning: to enrol or put one's name down
playfully, sub means under and a scribe is a writer

explanation.definitionFit: To subscribe is to sign up, and literally to write one's name underneath.

clue.text: Head of clan requires cook to admit one before volunteers get in

indicators.note: to admit means the cook lets the numeral one inside

parts.note: a chef is a cook
I is the Roman numeral one
TA, the Territorial Army, was Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: A clan leader needs a cook to let one in before volunteer troops arrive.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA (Territorial Army) is the British volunteer reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A chieftain is the leader of a clan or tribe.

clue.text: Form of worship

parts.note: a form is a backless bench, and this is the bench found in a church

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as a style of religious service, but 'form' is a long bench, as in a British school form.
explanation.definitionFit: A church bench is a seat used during worship, a form in the bench sense.

clue.text: Most of the fruit or vegetable

indicators.note: most of means one final letter is dropped from the fruit's name

parts.note: a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Most of the produce is either fruit or veg.
explanation.definitionFit: A pea is a small green vegetable.

clue.text: Possessing endless ingenuity

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: with can mean possessing, as in a man with money

explanation.surface: Having boundless cleverness.
explanation.definitionFit: Wit is quick inventive intelligence, close to ingenuity.

clue.text: Jester's desire — amusement sparked by a sentence?

definitions.meaning: what a court jester wants is to make the royal court laugh
in a court of law, a judge's quip or sentence may make the room laugh

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes mirth in a courtroom, and literally a jester's goal at a royal court.

clue.text: Skill seen in party piece

indicators.note: seen in says the letters can be spotted inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A talent shown off in someone's party piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Art can mean a skill or craft, as in the art of conversation.

clue.text: Ring the woman in strife

indicators.note: in places the woman inside the word for strife

parts.note: war is conflict or strife
she refers to a woman

explanation.surface: A ring involving a woman caught up in conflict.
explanation.definitionFit: A washer is a flat ring placed under a nut or bolt.

clue.text: Get back from playing area with love in the air

parts.note: rec, short for recreation ground, is a British playing field
O is zero, love in tennis scoring
up means aloft

explanation.surface: Recovering from a sports ground with romance in the air.
explanation.walkthrough: A rec is a British public recreation ground.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoup is to recover or regain something lost, to get it back.

clue.text: Frisky setter's way

indicators.note: frisky means lively, suggesting the letters jump around

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A playful setter dog's route.
explanation.definitionFit: A street is a road or way, as in Watling Way.

clue.text: Boating teams discussed pleasure trip

indicators.note: discussed means the words are spoken, so we want something that sounds like them

parts.note: crews are teams who row or sail boats

explanation.surface: Rowing squads talked about a holiday voyage.
explanation.definitionFit: A cruise is a sea voyage taken for pleasure.

clue.text: Risk these days putting outlet by river

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, is the era we live in now
a vent is an opening that lets something out
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Taking a gamble nowadays by placing a drain beside a river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ure is a river in North Yorkshire, England, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: To adventure is to venture or risk something, a dated verb sense.

clue.text: Creatively, I tarry — that's not common

indicators.note: creatively suggests the letters are freely reworked into something new

explanation.surface: I dawdle in an artistic way, and that's unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: A rarity is something uncommon, so the phrase describes it.

clue.text: One's in one country or another

indicators.note: in puts one word inside the named country

parts.note: India is a country
One's read as the plural ones

explanation.surface: A person is in one nation or a different one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One country' tempts as the definition, but the definition is only 'another': a second nation, holding the plural of 'one'. 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Indonesia is a nation, so it is another country besides India.

clue.text: Cricket side getting part of the wicket out temporarily?

parts.note: the on side is one half of a cricket field
a bail is one of the small crosspieces resting on the stumps

explanation.surface: A cricket team losing part of its wicket, so its batsman is briefly out.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the on (leg) side is one half of the field; bails sit on top of the stumps.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone released pending trial is out of custody for the time being.

clue.text: Gambler tours Bath perhaps to dish the dirt?

indicators.note: tours means the gambler goes round the spa town

parts.note: a better is someone who bets
Bath is an English spa town, an example of a spa

explanation.surface: A gambler visits Bath to spread scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: Bath is a spa city in Somerset, England.
explanation.definitionFit: To spatter with mud is literally to throw dirt about, so the gossip idiom is used playfully.
